Me, I am farming this small maize shamba near my home. The rains here in Mwanza, they come once, so I must plant when the rains start in November and hope God gives us enough. I do not have money to buy fertilizer from the shop — the prices are too high and the voucher does not always reach us. I will put the manure from our few goats and chickens on the plot before planting, and I will use the seed I kept from last harvest because the improved seed costs too much at the agrodealer. My husband and I will do the work ourselves with the hand-hoe, but when the weeds come fast after the rains, I may call one or two neighbours to help for a few days and pay them with food or a small money.
